📖 How to use

      
  1. Choose an animation type (fade, slide, bounce, spin, pulse, shake).
  2. Set the duration, timing function, iteration count and delay.
  3. Watch the live preview update instantly.
  4. Click "Copy CSS" and paste the @keyframes + class into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does the generated code need any library?
The code is plain CSS3 with no dependencies. It works in all modern browsers; older browsers may need vendor prefixes, which the generator omits by default.
Can I rename the animation class?
Yes — the class name uses a generic name like .animate-fade-in and the keyframes have matching names. You can rename them freely in the copied code.
What range do duration and iterations cover?
The duration slider covers 0.2s to 5s and iteration can be a fixed count or infinite. For longer loops, edit the duration value in the copied CSS.
